newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Proton confirms Mitsubishi car plans.
newsitem.headline: Proton confirms Mitsubishi car plans.

text.p: Malaysian carmaker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) confirmed on Friday that it was jointly developing a range of cars with Japan's Mitsubishi Motors Corp.
"Proton is developing a wide range of cars. Discussions (are) with all key partners including Mitsubishi," a Proton spokesperson told Reuters.
"The project will be led by Proton," she added, without giving other details.
A Japanese newspaper reported on Friday that Proton, makers of Malaysia's designated "national car", and Mitsubishi Motors will jointly develop two small cars in Malaysia.
Mitsubishi Motors and Mitsubishi Corp each own 8.6 percent of Proton, and have been the key partners in Malaysia's national car project since its launch in 1985.
The Yomiuri Shimbun newspaper said the cars will be mainly developed by Proton, with Mitsubishi Motors providing technical assistance.
The daily added that Proton will develop the platforms and other major parts for the cars, which will be powered by engines made by Mitsubishi Motors.
